verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official Model Context Protocol server that lets developers use natural language from their chosen LLM client to connect with Adyen's platform, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. However, the evidence never shows which tools or operations it exposes, or whether those cover in-person or Terminal API functions. missing for 10: documented tool coverage for in-person/Terminal API operations, setup and authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
